title.zh: OpenAI 模型：GPT-6 Astra、GPT-Image-2、Sol、Terra 与 Codex。

description.zh: GPT-6 Astra 已上线处理推理任务；GPT-Image-2 已通过画图 Combo 上线；已配置的 Sol、Terra 与 Codex 画像仍位于主选择器下层。

prompts.en: Turn this brief into an image

title.en: Astra is the OpenAI route for high-stakes reasoning in the client.
title.zh: Astra 是客户端中承担高要求推理的 OpenAI 路径。

description.en: This page separates what users can select now from image generation in a Combo and code-specialized capacity prepared below the picker.
description.zh: 本页明确区分当前可直接选择的 Astra、通过 Combo 使用的图像能力，以及选择器下层已准备的代码专用容量。

description.en: Astra handles complex instructions, decisions, and agent orchestration.
description.zh: Astra 处理复杂指令、决策与 Agent 编排。

description.en: Best where the cost of a weak plan is high.
description.zh: 适合薄弱方案会造成高成本后果的任务。

description.en: GPT-Image-2 produces images rather than chat output.
description.zh: GPT-Image-2 生成图像，而不是作为文本对话型号出现。

description.en: Sol, Terra, and Codex remain below the main picker.
description.zh: Sol、Terra 与 Codex 当前仍未在主选择器露出。

title.en: Do not treat every GPT model as interchangeable.
title.zh: 不要把所有 GPT 模型视为可以互换。

description.en: The useful distinction is the job each model is meant to do, not only its generation number.
description.zh: 真正有用的区别是每个模型承担的工作，而不只是代际编号。

description.en: Strong reasoning and broad instruction following.
description.zh: 强推理与通用指令遵从。

description.en: 1M context and 272K cliff profiles configured below the picker.
description.zh: 已配置 1M 上下文与 272K cliff 画像，未在主选择器露出。

description.en: Code-specialized models with 400K / 128K capacity configuration.
description.zh: 代码专用模型，已配置 400K / 128K 容量。

description.en: High-quality image, illustration, and cover generation.
description.zh: 高质量图片、插画与封面图生成。

title.en: Use the live OpenAI capability that matches the deliverable.
title.zh: 根据交付物选择已经上线的 OpenAI 能力。

description.en: A reasoning task and an image brief should not be forced through the same product entry.
description.zh: 推理任务与图像简报不应被塞进同一个产品入口。

brief.en: Resolve competing requirements before committing to implementation.
brief.zh: 在进入实现前解决相互冲突的需求。

process.en: Astra follows constraints, compares consequences, and builds an actionable direction.
process.zh: Astra 跟踪约束、比较后果并形成可执行方向。

outcome.en: A reasoned decision ready for the project team.
outcome.zh: 一份可交给项目团队执行的推理结论。

brief.en: Coordinate a multi-step task that mixes planning and execution.
brief.zh: 协调一个混合规划与执行的多步骤任务。

process.en: Astra keeps the instruction hierarchy in view while the task progresses.
process.zh: Astra 在任务推进中持续把握指令层级。

outcome.en: A coherent run instead of disconnected answers.
outcome.zh: 一段连贯执行，而不是互不相连的回答。

title.zh: 根据创意简报生成图像

brief.en: Produce an illustration, cover, or campaign visual.
brief.zh: 制作插画、封面或活动视觉。

process.en: The `ai-image-drawing` Combo sends the visual task to GPT-Image-2.
process.zh: `ai-image-drawing` Combo 将视觉任务交给 GPT-Image-2。

outcome.en: A visual asset rather than another text response.
outcome.zh: 获得视觉资产，而不是另一段文字回答。

title.en: One provider family, accurately separated by product surface.
title.zh: 同一供应商系列，按产品入口准确区分。

description.en: Only live capabilities receive a direct-use claim; configured models retain their exact readiness label.
description.zh: 只有已上线能力才声称可直接使用；已配置型号继续保持准确的就绪状态标识。

description.en: GPT-6 Astra is selectable for complex reasoning and broad instruction following.
description.zh: GPT-6 Astra 可直接用于复杂推理与通用指令遵从。

description.en: Astra is positioned for deep Agent orchestration and architecture-level work.
description.zh: Astra 面向深度 Agent 编排与架构级工作。

description.en: GPT-Image-2 is live as the default high-quality model in `ai-image-drawing`.
description.zh: GPT-Image-2 已作为 `ai-image-drawing` 的默认高质量生图模型上线。

description.en: Sol, Terra, and Codex profiles are configured but not exposed in the picker.
description.zh: Sol、Terra 与 Codex 画像已配置，但未在选择器露出。

title.en: Choose the available route, not only the model name.
title.zh: 选择真实可用的路径，而不只是一个模型名称。

items.en: The task needs strong reasoning before implementation.
items.zh: 任务需要在实现前进行强推理。

items.en: You are coordinating several dependent Agent steps.
items.zh: 你正在协调多个相互依赖的 Agent 步骤。

items.en: Instruction following and architectural judgment matter together.
items.zh: 指令遵从与架构判断同样重要。

title.zh: 这些情况使用其他 Floatboat 路径

items.en: The deliverable is an image; open the drawing Combo.
items.zh: 交付物是图像，应打开画图 Combo。

items.en: You need faster routine processing; consider a Flash model.
items.zh: 需要更快处理常规任务，可考虑 Flash 型号。

items.en: Do not select Sol, Terra, or Codex from the main picker; they are not exposed there.
items.zh: 不要尝试在主选择器选择 Sol、Terra 或 Codex，它们尚未露出。

title.zh: 推理、构建、快速响应或生成图像。

description.en: Use when the task needs careful reasoning before action.
description.zh: 用于需要先严谨推理、再采取行动的任务。

description.en: Use for implementation-heavy coding and sustained technical work.
description.zh: 用于实现密集型编程与持续技术工作。

description.en: Configured code-specialized capacity below the main picker.
description.zh: 已在主选择器下层配置代码专用模型容量。

description.en: Use when the deliverable is visual rather than another block of text.
description.zh: 用于交付物是视觉内容，而不是另一段文字的任务。

question.en: Which OpenAI models are covered on this page?
question.zh: 本页包含哪些 OpenAI 模型？

answer.en: The matrix covers GPT-6 Astra, GPT-Image-2, GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra, and GPT-5.3 Codex and Codex Spark, with their distinct roles and status.
answer.zh: 矩阵包含 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-Image-2、GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Terra，以及 GPT-5.3 Codex 与 Codex Spark，并区分各自角色和状态。

question.en: What work is GPT-6 Astra intended for?
question.zh: GPT-6 Astra 适合什么工作？

answer.en: Astra is the live OpenAI option for flagship reasoning, complex instruction following, architecture decisions, and deep Agent orchestration.
answer.zh: Astra 是已上线的 OpenAI 旗舰推理选项，适合复杂指令遵从、架构决策与深度 Agent 编排。

question.en: Why is GPT Image 2 listed with text models?
question.zh: 为什么 GPT Image 2 与文本模型列在一起？

answer.en: It represents a different output lane—image generation—within the same broader workflow and project context.
answer.zh: 它代表同一完整工作流与项目上下文中的另一条输出路径：图像生成。

answer.en: GPT-Image-2 is positioned for high-quality image generation, illustrations, cover artwork, and other visual deliverables.
answer.zh: GPT-Image-2 面向高质量图片生成、插画、封面图以及其他视觉交付物。

question.en: What are GPT-5.3 Codex and Codex Spark for?
question.zh: GPT-5.3 Codex 与 Codex Spark 有什么用途？

answer.en: They are code-specialized evaluation profiles with configured 400K and 128K capacity, respectively.
answer.zh: 它们属于代码专用评测画像，分别配置了 400K 与 128K 容量。

title.en: Match the GPT lane to the deliverable.
title.zh: 让 GPT 能力路径匹配最终交付物。

description.en: Choose Astra for reasoning now, and use the wider OpenAI matrix as each capability becomes available in its product surface.
description.zh: 当前用 Astra 处理推理任务，并在相应产品界面开放时使用更广泛的 OpenAI 能力矩阵。
